children.name: At Levain & Crust, we believe bread is alive. Our baking rhythm follows the ancient laws of traditional baking. We don't use commercial yeasts, chemical dough conditioners, or speed up the fermentation. Every single loaf is leavened entirely by our wild starter, nurtured daily since 2017. Our grains are sourced from family-run mills committed to dry-land soil preservation, stone-ground to retain the wheat germ's natural oils and minerals. The result is bread that smells like the field, digests easily, and is truly good for the soul.
